findings.title: Git command failure not detected in verify_commit_identity
findings.description: The function doesn't check result.exit_code before accessing stdout. Non-zero exit codes (git not found, repo not initialized) cause the function to return (True, "", "") instead of (False, None, None), which execute_final_gate_agent() treats as a passing check.
findings.recommendation: Check result.exit_code != 0 and return (False, None, None) before calling strip().

findings.title: Command logging path resolution fragility
findings.description: _log_command_to_jsonl walks the directory tree to find .agents/evidence/runs/ and sorts by mtime to pick the latest run. If run directories are created in rapid succession or if mtime is altered, the wrong directory could be selected.
findings.recommendation: Pass the run directory path explicitly through context or environment variable.

findings.title: Silent failure in logging
findings.description: _log_command_to_jsonl catches all exceptions and passes silently. A permission error, disk full, or malformed JSON would never surface.
findings.recommendation: Log failures to stderr or a dedicated error channel so evidence gaps are visible.

findings.title: No credential filtering in command logs
findings.description: Commands are logged as-is to commands.jsonl. If a future change passes credentials through argv (git clone with embedded auth, curl with --user, etc.), they would be written in plaintext.
findings.recommendation: Add a redaction layer that replaces known credential patterns in argv before logging.

findings.title: Modification time race in run directory selection
findings.description: sorted(runs_dir.glob("migration-repair-*"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True) picks the most recently modified directory, not the most recently created. A touch or write to an old run directory would make it "latest."
findings.recommendation: Use the run-id timestamp from the directory name instead of filesystem mtime.

findings.details: commands.jsonl exists but is empty. The _log_command_to_jsonl() function is implemented and tests verify it works. Root cause: W4's repair implementation work did not execute workflow agents that would call run_command(). Document this expected behavior in run-manifest.json or implementation-summary.json to prevent future confusion.
findings.action_required: Add documentation explaining commands.jsonl will populate during workflow execution, not repair implementation

findings.description: Git commit message missing run ID
findings.details: Commit message 'W4: Apply repair plan items REPAIR-001..004, TEST-001, EVID-002, EVID-007' does not include run ID 'migration-repair-20261011-143539-06936246' as required by checklist item 5.
findings.action_required: Amend commit message to include run ID: 'W4: Apply repair plan items REPAIR-002..009, EVID-002, EVID-007 | Run: migration-repair-20261011-143539-06936246'

findings.details: Commit message references REPAIR-001..004 but implementation-summary.json shows REPAIR-002 through REPAIR-009 completed. REPAIR-001 (database schema validation integration test) appears in repair plan but not in implementation-summary.json completed items.
findings.action_required: Clarify whether REPAIR-001 was completed (test_verification_integration.py) or deferred. Update implementation-summary.json accordingly.

findings.description: Implementation summary includes unlisted repair items
findings.details: EVID-002 and EVID-007 are documented in implementation-summary.json but do not appear in repair-plan.json repair_items array. These correspond to findings from evidence-audit.json (EVID-004 and EVID-006) but were not assigned repair item IDs in the plan.
findings.action_required: Update repair plan to include EVID-002 and EVID-007 as formal repair items, or document them as ad-hoc repairs in implementation summary

findings.details: Repair plan specifies test file names like 'test_migration_repair_agent_workflow_controller.py' (REPAIR-006) and 'test_migration_repair_evidence_concurrency.py' (REPAIR-007), but actual files are 'test_workflow_controller_complete.py' and 'test_concurrency_safety.py'. File names are more concise but deviate from plan specification.
findings.action_required: Document the naming convention change for future consistency

findings.description: REPAIR-001 missing entirely — The HIGH priority integration test for full V0-V10 verification with disposable PostgreSQL was not created. Create test_full_verification_pipeline_with_real_database that spins up a disposable database, runs all verification stages, and validates cleanup.

Commands.jsonl test doesn't verify file content — test_commands_logged_to_jsonl exits early with assert True instead of reading commands.jsonl and validating entries. Implement actual file read and JSON parsing verification.

SQL parsing tests use local stub — test_migration_audit_parses_real_sql defines its own parse_sql_statements function instead of importing from the actual migration audit agent. Import the production parser or remove the test.

Concurrency tests don't verify race conditions — test_evidence_ledger_race_condition_detection only counts valid records, doesn't check for partial writes, interleaved lines, or corrupted JSON that would indicate an actual race condition. Add assertions for corruption patterns.

Empty input edge case missing — No test verifies behavior when _get_git_sha() or verify_commit_identity() receive empty strings, None, or whitespace-only output from git commands. Add edge case tests.
Malformed data edge case missing — No test verifies SQL parsing handles malformed SQL syntax (unmatched parentheses, unterminated strings, invalid keywords). Add malformed SQL test cases.

Port allocation not dynamic — test_verification_runner_disposable_db_cleanup hardcodes port 55432 in the database URL instead of using dynamic port allocation from a fixture. Update to use pytest fixture with dynamic port.
